title: Theme file
description: A theme is what an app selects with data-theme (ADR-018, CONTRACT-002 amendment): one brand plus an anatomy. The anatomy is either a shared design system (designSystem: material, fluent, carbon) or the theme's own (anatomy: the same fonts, tokens and appearances a design system file holds). Exactly one of the two.

brand.description: The name of a brand file in tokens/brands/.

designSystem.description: The name of a shared design system in tokens/design-systems/.

anatomy.description: The theme's own anatomy, for a theme that is not built on a shared design system.

public.description: Whether the published site lists the theme (its page at themes/?theme=<name> is linked from the theme list). Themes are unlisted unless this is true; an unlisted theme's page still opens for anyone who types its name, and the theme still ships in @ux-builder/tokens.

default.description: The appearance applied when the app sets no data-appearance. Defaults to dark when the brand defines dark, else the brand's only appearance.
